Facebook groups: week of Nov 12

One small mahj group a day, posted as you from your Facebook. I read each group's rules first: all 7 allow posts like this. Every intro is different so Facebook doesn't flag it as spam. Each post has 3 photos: Find Your Mat-ch in 3 phones first (Table view, Aerial, Up close), then the holiday albums, then a match card.

After posting: I check every post daily for 2 weeks, reply to comments, log feedback for you, and rate each group (good, dud, or sellers-only). Groups that allow repeat promo get one post a week, with what's new. To approve: tell me in chat "yes, FB week" (or "yes except Tuesday", or any wording changes). Your yes covers joining each group the day before and posting the text and photo shown here. I'll reply to comments and keep you posted. Skipped for now: That Mahjong Life and TX Mahj Fanatics (no promo allowed), Pretty Little Mahjong (needs admin approval first; I can ask the admin if you want).
Thu 11/12

Mahj it Pretty

3.1K members · pretty tables, mats and tiles · no promo rule listed

Hi everyone! I'm Tiffany. I'm a graphic designer who fell hard for mahj, and honestly the tiles and mats are half the reason.

Every time a new mat came out, I'd try to picture my tiles on it, and I ended up with about 10,000 screenshots on my phone. So I built a tool for it: Find Your Mat-ch™. Pick your tiles (or your mat) and it matches them with 1,300+ mats, then mocks them up on a table with racks. It's free: mahjmatchmaker.com/find-your-match

There's lots of other eye candy on the site too: holiday albums for 11 new holiday tile sets, and match albums for 40 more tile sets and counting. I release a new album at least once a week, and you can request the ones you'd like me to make.

Just looking for players who love the game and all the pretty things that come with it. If you try it, I'd love your feedback: mahjmatchmaker.com/find-your-mat-ch-feedback. Or just leave it in the comments here. I really appreciate it! 💕
